command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
since=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "round" && $4 !~ /^implement#/ { print $1; exit }')
start=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "task" && $4 == "started" { print $1; exit }')
[ -n "$since" ] || since=$(git rev-parse "$start^" 2>/dev/null || git merge-base HEAD origin/main)
changed=$({ git diff --name-only "$since"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
forbidden=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '^(openspec/|temporary-docs/|\.gnomish/|\.github/|\.claude/|docs/adr/|CLAUDE\.md$)' | grep -vxF "$change/tasks.md" | grep -v "^$reports/handoff/" || true)
[ -z "$forbidden" ] || { echo "$forbidden"; echo "the implement stage edits only packages/, docs/ outside docs/adr/, the checkboxes of $change/tasks.md and $reports/handoff/ - put changes to these paths into a handoff patch (see .gnomish/stages/specify/handoff.md) and restore the files above with: git checkout $since -- <file>"; exit 1; }
dependencies=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '(^|/)(package\.json|pnpm-lock\.yaml)$' || true)
if [ -n "$dependencies" ] && ! grep -qiE 'pnpm add|dependenc|package\.json' "$change/tasks.md"; then echo "$dependencies"; echo "tasks.md asks for no dependency or package.json change - restore the files above with: git checkout $since -- <file>"; exit 1; fi

command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
for patch in "$reports"/handoff/*.patch; do
  [ -e "$patch" ] || continue
  git apply --check "$patch" || { echo "$patch does not apply to the branch - regenerate it as .gnomish/stages/specify/handoff.md describes"; exit 1; }
done
if grep -qE '^- H[0-9]+' "$change/tasks.md" && [ ! -f "$reports/handoff/README.md" ]; then
  echo "tasks.md lists handoff items under Human follow-up but $reports/handoff/README.md is missing"; exit 1
fi

findings.message: NFR-A1 / M8 and specs/grid-view/spec.md:206 ('With a meeting range set, axe-core SHALL report no violations on the Grid view in the light and the dark theme, with and without a share notice'; scenario 'No accessibility violations in the meeting state' — 'THEN it reports no violations') are not met. packages/client/src/test/features/grid_view/steps/grid_view_meeting_share_e2e.steps.ts:178 removes every dimmed hour cell from the scan with `.exclude("[data-hour-cell].opacity-40")`, and its comment admits the reason: 'The digits of dimmed cells are left out: the spec fixes their opacity at 0.4 (FR7, UX1), which no digit colour can lift to 4.5:1.' So the meeting state does have colour-contrast violations, and the test that should prove 0 violations hides them. The exclusion also turns off every axe rule for those nodes, not only color-contrast. No other axe test in src/test excludes nodes. Fix it one of two ways: (a) make the dimmed cells pass contrast, for example by dimming the cell background or fill but keeping the digits at a contrasting colour, while FR7 and the design still read the same, then drop the exclusion; or (b) record the contrast exception for dimmed cells and its reason in this change's spec delta (grid-view 'No accessibility violations in the meeting state'), proposal NFR-A1 and M8, and narrow the test to the color-contrast rule on those nodes only instead of a blanket `.exclude`.

findings.message: Handoff H3 (temporary-docs/gnomish/github-oinsio-time-zones-108/handoff/H3-adr-0012-capability-scoped-contract.patch) creates a second ADR-0012. The number is already taken by 'User-chosen view' from the archived change 2026-11-09-add-view-mode-setting-and-grid-skeleton (its proposal: "new ADR-0012 'The user chooses the view; no automatic choice by width'"). The docs already link that ADR as `0012-user-chosen-view.md`: docs/architecture/overview.md:20 "[ADR-0012](../adr/0012-user-chosen-view.md) | User-chosen view: no automatic view by width, Cards by default", docs/architecture/views.md:3 and :137, docs/architecture/domain-model.md:49, docs/glossary/views.md:7. The patch adds `docs/adr/0012-capability-scoped-view-contract-scenarios.md` titled 'ADR-0012: Capability-scoped view-contract scenarios'. Its CLAUDE.md hunk lists '0012 capability-scoped view contract', and ADR-0005 gains 'Refined by [ADR-0012](0012-capability-scoped-view-contract-scenarios.md)', so applying it leaves two decisions under one number. Give the new ADR the next free number (0013) in the patch, the CLAUDE.md line, ADR-0005's Status line and the H3 section of handoff/README.md, and record the departure from tasks.md 10.3 in the README.
